svg.title: AI Use Case Prioritisation Matrix
svg.desc: Two-by-two matrix of business value against implementation feasibility. High value and high feasibility: Quick Wins, do first. High value and low feasibility: Strategic Bets, plan for later. Low value and high feasibility: Incremental Gains, do if capacity allows. Low value and low feasibility: Avoid, don't do.
svg.text: Score each use case on business value and implementation feasibility.
Low value, but easy to deliver
